[P3] 嗡——嗡！
机器人马克斯发现外星人正在
攻击太空卫兵，准备救援！

[P4] 噢，天哪！马克斯又散架了！
我生气极了，把它扔了出去。

妈妈说，生气时扔东西是不对的。
她没收了我的太空玩具。

[P5] 但是，如果他玩我的火车玩具，我就会很生气。
妈妈跟他说过这套火车玩具是我的，但他还是总想玩。上次看见他玩我的火车，我太生气了，就用火车头打了他。

弟弟西蒙把我的光剑玩具递给了我。
有时，我真的很喜欢和他一起玩。
我们一起玩玩具很开心。

[P6] 妈妈说，生气时打人是不对的。她让我坐在反省椅上，还没收了我的火车玩具。

妈妈说，我应该学会控制自己的情绪。生气时，扔东西和打人都是不对的，我需要找到别的方式来表达。

她说，从现在开始，生气时我就得说出来，比如“我生气了”“我太生气了”或者“我需要帮助！”然后，再谈谈我为什么生气，或者我需要什么样的帮助，这样才能找出解决的办法。

[P7] 妈妈拿出了一张纸，上面
画满了圆圈。她说这是给我准备的笑脸图，每次我生气时能说出来，就可以在其中的一个圆圈里画上一个笑脸。

如果画满所有的笑脸，就能实现我的一个愿望，比如租一部电影、吃一顿比萨晚餐，或者在客厅里搭帐篷。

妈妈说，如果我用玩具打人，玩具也要被放进反省箱里，而且我还得坐反省椅。

[P9] Josh's
Smiley Faces

嘿嘿！西蒙在玩我最喜欢的太空卫兵玩具！我一把夺过来，正准备对他动手，妈妈说：‘比萨！’我立刻放下了手。

妈妈说：‘听起来真不错！’
于是，我们在那张笑脸图上画了一个比萨，上面还有意大利辣肠！然后，我们把它挂在了墙上。

[P10] 我说：“我生气了！”
妈妈问：“你为什么生气呀？”
“因为西蒙玩我的玩具！”我回答。

妈妈让我再找一个玩具和弟弟交换。

[P11] 西蒙和我交换了玩具。

就这样生气时说出来，我又得到了三个笑脸！
后来，我玩摩托车组装玩具时，很努力地想把它组装起来，
可是那些零件怎么也拼不上。我气得把它们扔了。
啊！

“好样的！孩子们！”妈妈说。
她吻了我和西蒙，然后给我画了一个笑脸。

[P12] 妈妈把那些零件放进了反省箱里。她说："记住，生气时要说出来，而且你可以随时要求帮助。"
妈妈说，我只能第二天早上才能拿回玩具。

妈妈真讨厌！我太生气了！我回到房间，把我所有的衣服从衣橱里扔了出来。
衣服乱七八糟地堆在了地板上。

[P13] 妈妈把那些零件放进了反省箱里。她说："记住，生气时要说出来，而且你可以随时要求帮助。"
妈妈说，我只能第二天早上才能拿回玩具。

妈妈真讨厌！我太生气了！我回到房间，把我所有的衣服从衣橱里扔了出来。
衣服乱七八糟地堆在了地板上。

[P14] 妈妈打开门，说：“哇！好乱啊！”
我告诉她，我生气极了。
“你为什么这么生气啊？”她问。
“因为得笑脸太难了。”
她说她可以帮助我，但我得先把衣服整理好。

我捡起地上的衣服，把它们放回衣橱。妈妈也帮我整理。
她说，生气时说出来是需要练习的。她觉得我做得非常好。

[P15] 这时，我看见西蒙在玩我的棒球手套。我递给他一只毛绒狗，说：“西蒙，这是你的玩具。”
我拿回了我的手套，西蒙也没有介意，妈妈笑了。
“交换玩具是个好主意哦！”她说，“我真为你骄傲！”
她拥抱了我并又给我画了一个笑脸。

[P16] 我的笑脸图终于画满了！
我说，晚餐我要吃意大利辣肠比萨。
哟喵！

我会继续练习，用语言表达我的愤怒，并且可以找爸爸妈妈来帮我。我想，如果我做得非常棒，是不是可以实现去外太空拜访我最喜欢的太空卫兵的愿望呢？

[P3] Buzz—buzz!
Robot Max discovers aliens attacking space soldiers and is ready to rescue them!

[P4] Oh, no! Max is broken again!
I was so angry, I threw it out.

Mom said, throwing things when you're angry is not right.
She took away my space toy.

[P5] But if he plays with my train toys, I get very angry.
Mom told him these train toys are mine, but he still always wants to play with them. Last time I saw him playing with my train, I was so angry, I hit him with the train engine.

My brother Simon handed me my light-saber toy.
Sometimes, I really like playing with him.
We have a lot of fun playing with toys together.

[P6] Mom said, it's wrong to hit people when you're angry. She made me sit on the thinking chair and took away my train toy.

Mom said, I should learn to control my emotions. When I'm angry, throwing things and hitting people are wrong, and I need to find other ways to express myself.

She said, from now on, when I'm angry, I need to speak up, like 'I'm angry,' 'I'm really angry,' or 'I need help!' Then, I should talk about why I'm angry, or what kind of help I need, so we can find a solution together.

[P7] Mom took out a piece of paper with circles drawn on it. She said it was a smiley face chart for me, and every time I could express my anger, I could draw a smiley face inside one of the circles.

If I filled all the smiley faces, I could get one wish, like renting a movie, having a pizza dinner, or setting up a tent in the living room.

[P9] Josh's
Smiley Faces

Hey! Simon is playing with my favorite space soldier toy! I grabbed it and was about to hit him, but Mom said, 'Pizza!' I immediately let go.

Mom said, 'That sounds great!'
So, we drew a pizza with pepperoni on that smiley face chart, and then we hung it on the wall.

[P10] I said, "I'm angry!"
Mom asked, "Why are you angry?"
"Because Simon is playing with my toys!" I answered.

Mom told me to find another toy to exchange with my brother.

[P11] Simon and I exchanged toys.

By saying how I felt when I was angry, I got three more smiley faces!
Later, when I was trying to assemble my motorcycle toy, I worked really hard to put it together,
but the pieces just wouldn't fit. I got so angry I threw them all.
Ah!

"Good job, kids!" Mom said.
She kissed Simon and me, then drew a smiley face for me.

[P12] Mom put those parts into the time-out box. She said, "Remember, when you're angry, you need to speak up, and you can always ask for help."
Mom said, I can only get my toys back the next morning.

Mom is so annoying! I'm so angry! I went back to my room and threw all my clothes out of the closet.
The clothes were piled up messily on the floor.

[P13] Mom put those pieces into the time-out box. She said, "Remember, when you're angry, you need to speak up, and you can always ask for help."
Mom said, I can only get my toys back the next morning.

Mom is so annoying! I'm so angry! I went back to my room and threw all my clothes out of the closet.
The clothes were piled up messily on the floor.

[P14] Mom opened the door and said, “Wow! What a mess!”
I told her I was really angry.
“Why are you so angry?” she asked.
“Because getting a smiley face is too hard.”
She said she could help me, but I had to tidy up my clothes first.

I picked up the clothes on the floor and put them back in the closet. Mom helped me too.
She said, speaking up when you’re angry is something you need to practice. She thought I did a very good job.

[P15] At this moment, I saw Simon playing with my baseball glove. I gave him a stuffed dog and said, "Simon, this is your toy." 
I got my glove back, and Simon didn't mind. Mom smiled. 
"Exchanging toys is a great idea!" she said. "I'm so proud of you!" 
She hugged me and drew another smiley face for me.

[P16] My smiley face chart is finally full!
I said, I want to eat Italian pepperoni pizza for dinner.
Yay!

I will keep practicing using words to express my anger, and I can ask Mommy and Daddy for help. I wonder, if I do really well, can I achieve my wish to visit my favorite space soldier in outer space?
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《妈妈，我真的很生气》的封面，展示了书名、副标题、作者、绘者、译者信息，以及美国心理学会官方授权标识和出版社信息。画面中央是一个生气的小男孩，周围环绕着多个笑脸。
[P2] 本页为绘本《妈妈，我真的很生气》的扉页，展示了书名、副标题、作者、绘者、译者及出版社信息。
[P3] 一个男孩正在房间里玩机器人玩具，他举起一个机器人，仿佛在进行太空救援，画面充满想象力和童趣。
[P4] 小男孩因玩具机器人散架而生气，将其扔出；妈妈认为扔东西不对，于是没收了他的太空玩具。
[P5] 本页通过左右两栏对比，展现了男孩与弟弟西蒙相处的矛盾：一方面，弟弟分享光剑玩具时他们玩得很开心；另一方面，当弟弟玩男孩的火车玩具时，男孩会因生气而用火车头打他。
[P6] 本页通过左右两栏对比，左侧男孩坐在反省椅上，妈妈没收了他的火车玩具；右侧男孩愤怒地握紧拳头，妈妈教导他学会用语言表达情绪，而不是通过打人或扔东西，并引导他说出感受和需求，以找到解决问题的方法。
[P7] 妈妈为男孩准备了一张笑脸图，鼓励他在生气时表达情绪，并承诺画满笑脸后可以实现一个愿望，如看电影、吃披萨或搭帐篷。
[P9] 男孩因弟弟西蒙玩他的太空卫兵玩具而生气，准备动手时被妈妈用‘比萨’一词制止。随后，妈妈和男孩一起在笑脸图上画了一个带意大利辣肠的比萨，并将其挂上墙，作为情绪管理的奖励记录。
[P10] 男孩因弟弟西蒙玩他的玩具而生气，妈妈询问原因后，建议他找另一个玩具与弟弟交换，以解决冲突。
[P11] 本页通过左右两栏对比，展现了男孩与弟弟西蒙交换玩具后获得奖励的积极互动，以及男孩因无法组装摩托车玩具而生气扔东西的负面行为。妈妈在左侧表扬并奖励了孩子们的友好行为，而在右侧则通过笑脸图记录情绪管理的成果。
[P12] 本页通过左右两栏对比，左侧妈妈将男孩的玩具零件放入反省箱，并教导他生气时要表达情绪并寻求帮助，约定第二天早上才能取回玩具；右侧男孩因愤怒而将衣物从衣橱中扔出，导致房间一片混乱。
[P13] 本页通过左右两栏对比，左侧妈妈将男孩的玩具零件放入反省箱，并教导他生气时要表达情绪并寻求帮助，约定第二天早上才能取回玩具；右侧男孩因愤怒而将衣物从衣橱中扔出，导致房间一片混乱。
[P14] 男孩因情绪管理困难而把房间弄乱，妈妈进门后引导他表达情绪并一起整理衣物，最终男孩在妈妈的鼓励下完成整理，获得正面反馈。
[P15] 男孩与弟弟西蒙交换玩具，妈妈表扬了这一友好行为，并为他画了一个笑脸作为奖励。
[P16] 男孩的笑脸图画满后，他兴奋地宣布晚餐要吃意大利辣肠比萨，并想象自己乘坐宇宙飞船去外太空拜访最喜欢的太空卫兵，表达了对情绪管理进步的喜悦和对未来愿望的憧憬。
